newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end shade up led by blue chip.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end shade up led by blue chip.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed marginally up on foreign buying of blue chip John Keells Holdings, brokers said.

The all share index closed 1.52 points up at 728.32. Price falls outpaced gains 29 to 19, but a sharp rise in the share price of highly capitalised John Keells supported the market. The share rose 13 rupees to 239.

"The foreign buyer was prepared to go up in his price since John Keells has not only shown good profit growth in the last financial year, but has good growth potential in the current year," said a broker who declined to be identified.
